content.title: SSYS Q2 Deep Dive: Lower Guidance Cites Delays in Large Deals, Cost Controls Offset Margin Pressures
content.summary: 3D printing company Stratasys (NASDAQ:SSYS) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2025, but sales were flat year on year at $138.1 million. On the other hand, the company’s full-year revenue guidance of $555 million at the midpoint came in 2.9% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.03 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
